name: Lilim
source:
Lilim is a cupid who failed to do her duties in Heaven properly, and was banished to the human world. Lilim is incredibly lazy, and will go through to any lengths possible to avoid working. Brash and self-confident, Lilim loves flirting with cute girls – but commitment is way too much of a hassle. Will she learn to change her ways?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/733740/Sakura_Cupid/]Steam[/url]]
